_about: Models the app offers. kind: speech (Whisper, CTranslate2 format for faster-whisper), voice, punctuation. cost: work relative to large-v3 (speed estimates). vram_gb: graphics memory needed at float16. source.repo: a Hugging Face repository; null means not offered for download yet.

models.name: GPU support (NVIDIA cuBLAS and cuDNN)
models.about: Lets the speech models run on your NVIDIA graphics card, many times faster than on the processor. Shown only on computers with an NVIDIA card.

models.name: Best accuracy (Whisper large-v3)
models.about: The most accurate general model. Best with an NVIDIA graphics card.

models.name: Fast and accurate (Whisper large-v3 turbo)
models.about: Nearly as accurate as large-v3 and several times faster. A good choice without a powerful graphics card.

models.name: Fast, English only (Distil-Whisper large-v3)
models.about: Close to large-v3 accuracy on English, much faster. English recordings only.

models.name: Medium (Whisper medium)
models.about: Smaller and faster than large, a little less accurate.

models.name: Small (Whisper small)
models.about: Quick on any computer; fine for clear recordings, weaker on accents and noise.

models.name: Hebrew, fast (ivrit.ai large-v3 turbo)
models.about: Whisper trained further on Hebrew by ivrit.ai: much better Hebrew than the general models.

models.name: Hebrew, best (ivrit.ai large-v3)
models.about: The most accurate Hebrew model from ivrit.ai. Best with an NVIDIA graphics card.

models.name: Speaker recognition (SpeechBrain ECAPA, ONNX)
models.about: Tells the voices apart. Needed for every transcription.

models.name: Punctuation repair (fullstop multilang large, ONNX)
models.about: Adds full stops and commas where Whisper leaves run-on text. Optional; English, German, French and Italian.
